controls.control: Separate partitions used for /tmp, /var, /var/log, /var/log/audit, /home
controls.audit_step: lsblk -f  and  cat /etc/fstab  — confirm /tmp, /var, /var/log, /var/log/audit, /home each have a separate partition entry

controls.control: Unused filesystems (cramfs, freevxfs, squashfs, udf) are disabled
controls.audit_step: modprobe -n -v cramfs freevxfs squashfs udf  — should show install /bin/true, or check /etc/modprobe.d/ for blacklist entries

controls.control: GPG keys are configured for package repositories
controls.audit_step:
rpm -q gpg-pubkey --qf '%{name}-%{version}
' (RHEL) or apt-key list / ls /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d (Debian)

controls.control: AppArmor/SELinux is installed, enabled and enforcing
controls.audit_step: sestatus (SELinux) or aa-status (AppArmor) — confirm status is enforcing/enabled

controls.control: Bootloader password is set and permissions restricted
controls.audit_step: cat /boot/grub2/grub.cfg | grep -i password  and  stat -c '%a %U' /boot/grub2/grub.cfg (should be 600, root-owned)

controls.control: Unnecessary services (telnet, rsh, ypserv, tftp, xinetd) are removed/disabled
controls.audit_step: systemctl list-unit-files | grep enabled | grep -E 'telnet|rsh|ypserv|tftp|xinetd'

controls.control: Time synchronization (chrony/ntp) is enabled and configured
controls.audit_step: systemctl status chronyd  or  timedatectl  — confirm 'NTP synchronized: yes'

controls.control: IP forwarding is disabled unless the host is a router
controls.audit_step: sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward  (expect 0 unless the host is an intended router)

controls.control: ICMP redirects, source routing are disabled
controls.audit_step: sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects  (expect 0)

controls.control: Host-based firewall (nftables/iptables/firewalld) is enabled with default-deny
controls.audit_step: systemctl status firewalld  or  nft list ruleset  or  iptables -L -n

controls.control: auditd is installed, enabled, and logs are retained per policy
controls.audit_step: systemctl status auditd  and  auditctl -l

controls.control: rsyslog/journald forwards logs to a central log server
controls.audit_step: cat /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf  — check for a remote @@loghost target

controls.control: Logrotate is configured to prevent disk exhaustion
controls.audit_step: cat /etc/logrotate.conf /etc/logrotate.d/*

controls.control: Password complexity, history, and lockout policy enforced via pam_pwquality/faillock
controls.audit_step: cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/faillock.conf

controls.control: SSH root login disabled, protocol 2 only, strong ciphers/MACs only
controls.audit_step: sshd -T | grep -Ei 'permitrootlogin|protocol|ciphers|macs'

controls.control: sudo requires password and logs all sudo activity
controls.audit_step: cat /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*  and  grep sudo /var/log/secure  (RHEL) or /var/log/auth.log (Debian)

controls.control: Empty passwords, unused/system accounts are locked or removed
controls.audit_step: awk -F: '($2 == "") {print $1}' /etc/shadow  and  passwd -Sa

controls.control: World-writable files and unowned files/directories are found and remediated
controls.audit_step: find / -xdev -type f -perm -0002 2>/dev/null

controls.control: Permissions on /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow are correctly restricted
controls.audit_step: stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/passwd /etc/shadow /etc/gshadow

controls.control: OS and package patching cadence is documented and current
controls.audit_step: yum history  (RHEL) or apt list --upgradable  (Debian), cross-checked against the patch management ticket/SOP

technologies.name: Windows Server / Active Directory
technologies.legacy_name: Windows Server / Active Directory (CIS Benchmark based)

controls.control: Password policy meets length/complexity/history/max-age requirements

controls.control: Account lockout threshold, duration and reset counter are configured

controls.control: Advanced audit policy is enabled for logon, account management, policy change

controls.control: Security options: LM hash storage disabled, NTLMv2 only, anonymous enumeration disabled

controls.control: Domain/Private/Public firewall profiles are all enabled with logging on

controls.control: SMBv1 is disabled; SMB signing is required

controls.control: Unnecessary services (Telnet, Remote Registry, SNMP if unused) are disabled

controls.control: LAPS or equivalent local admin password rotation is in place

controls.control: Windows Update is configured for timely patch deployment

controls.control: PowerShell logging (module, script block, transcription) is enabled

controls.control: Privileged groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins) are reviewed and minimized

controls.control: Kerberos delegation is restricted (no unconstrained delegation on non-critical hosts)
controls.audit_step: Get-ADComputer -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true}  and  Get-ADUser -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true}

controls.control: Tiered administration model separates workstation/server/DC admin credentials
controls.audit_step: Review AD OU structure, admin account naming/scoping, and interview the IT team on the documented tiering policy

controls.control: AD backups (including SYSVOL, NTDS.dit) are taken and tested regularly
controls.audit_step: wbadmin get versions  and check AD Recycle Bin status; perform/observe a test restore in a lab environment

controls.control: Microsoft Defender / EDR is installed, updated and reporting centrally
controls.audit_step: Get-MpComputerStatus  (PowerShell) or the EDR console's endpoint status dashboard

controls.control: BitLocker (or equivalent) full-disk encryption is enabled on all endpoints/servers with sensitive data
controls.audit_step: manage-bde -status  or  Get-BitLockerVolume  (PowerShell)

controls.control: Running a currently supported macOS major version with latest security updates applied
controls.audit_step: sw_vers  and  softwareupdate --history  — compare against Apple's currently supported release list

controls.control: FileVault full-disk encryption is enabled on all endpoints
controls.audit_step: fdesetup status  — confirm 'FileVault is On.'

controls.control: System Integrity Protection (SIP) is enabled
controls.audit_step: csrutil status  — confirm 'System Integrity Protection status: enabled.'

controls.control: Application firewall is enabled and stealth mode configured
controls.audit_step: /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --getglobalstate

controls.control: Remote Login (SSH) and Remote Management are disabled unless explicitly required
controls.audit_step: sudo systemsetup -getremotelogin  and  sudo /System/Library/CoreServices/RemoteManagement/ARDAgent.app/Contents/Resources/kickstart -status

controls.control: Password policy (length, complexity, expiration) is enforced via MDM configuration profile
controls.audit_step: pwpolicy -getaccountpolicies  or review the deployed MDM password policy payload

controls.control: Automatic login is disabled
controls.audit_step: sudo defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow autoLoginUser  (expect no value / error)

controls.control: Unified logging retention meets the organization's minimum window
controls.audit_step: log config --status  and  log show --last 24h --predicate 'eventType == logEvent'

controls.control: Automatic checking and installation of security updates is enabled
controls.audit_step: sudo softwareupdate --schedule  and  defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate

controls.control: Managed EDR/antivirus agent is installed, updated, and reporting centrally
controls.audit_step: Review the MDM/EDR console's endpoint enrollment and last-check-in status for the device

controls.control: Gatekeeper is enabled to restrict execution of unsigned/unnotarized applications
controls.audit_step: spctl --status  — confirm 'assessments enabled.'

technologies.name: Cloud
technologies.basis: AWS / Azure / GCP - CIS Benchmark based
technologies.legacy_name: Cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP - CIS Benchmark based)

controls.control: Root/global admin account has MFA enabled and is not used for daily operations
controls.audit_step: AWS: IAM console → root user MFA status, or aws iam get-account-summary. Azure: Entra ID → Global Admin MFA. GCP: Cloud Identity admin console

controls.control: IAM policies follow least privilege; no wildcard (*:*) admin policies attached broadly
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws iam get-account-authorization-details + IAM Access Analyzer. Azure: Entra ID PIM access reviews. GCP: gcloud projects get-iam-policy

controls.control: Access keys/service credentials are rotated and unused ones are disabled
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws iam list-access-keys (check CreateDate). Azure: App registration secrets expiry in Entra ID. GCP: gcloud iam service-accounts keys list

controls.control: Single sign-on / centralized identity provider is used instead of per-service local accounts
controls.audit_step: Check the Identity Center (AWS SSO) / Entra ID / Cloud Identity admin console for configured SSO and per-service local account policy

controls.control: Account-level audit logging (CloudTrail/Activity Log/Cloud Audit Logs) is enabled in all regions
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws cloudtrail describe-trails. Azure: Activity Log settings in the portal. GCP: gcloud logging sinks list

controls.control: Logs are shipped to a centralized, tamper-evident, access-controlled log store
controls.audit_step: Check the CloudTrail S3 bucket / Log Analytics workspace / Cloud Logging export destination and its access-control policy

controls.control: Alerting is configured for root usage, IAM policy changes, and security group changes
controls.audit_step: Check CloudWatch Alarms / Azure Monitor Alert rules / GCP Alerting policies scoped to root usage, IAM, and security-group changes

controls.control: Default security group / NSG denies all inbound traffic by default
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-names default. Azure: default NSG rules. GCP: default VPC firewall rules

controls.control: No security group/NSG rule allows unrestricted inbound access (0.0.0.0/0) on admin ports (22/3389)
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws ec2 describe-security-groups filtered for 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 22/3389. Azure/GCP: equivalent NSG/firewall rule review

controls.control: VPC/VNet flow logs are enabled
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws ec2 describe-flow-logs. Azure: Network Watcher → NSG Flow Logs. GCP: gcloud compute networks subnets describe (Flow Logs field)

controls.control: Object storage buckets/containers are not publicly readable/writable unless explicitly required
controls.audit_step: AWS: aws s3api get-bucket-policy-status. Azure: Storage Account → 'Allow Blob public access'. GCP: gsutil iam get gs://<bucket>

controls.control: Data at rest is encrypted using platform-managed or customer-managed keys
controls.audit_step: Check KMS/encryption settings on the storage or database resource in the respective cloud console

controls.control: Data in transit is enforced over TLS for all managed services
controls.audit_step: Check load balancer/API Gateway listener TLS policy configuration in the cloud console

controls.control: A cloud security posture / config-drift tool (Security Hub, Defender for Cloud, Security Command Center) is enabled
controls.audit_step: AWS Security Hub console / Microsoft Defender for Cloud / GCP Security Command Center dashboard

controls.control: Budget/cost anomaly alerts and resource tagging standards are enforced
controls.audit_step: AWS Budgets console / Azure Cost Management + Billing / GCP Billing budgets, and a tag-policy compliance report

controls.control: Container runtime (Docker/containerd) is kept patched to a supported version
controls.audit_step: docker version  /  containerd --version  compared against the vendor's currently supported release list

controls.control: Docker daemon socket is not exposed over an unauthenticated network port
controls.audit_step: netstat -tulpn | grep 2375  (should return nothing) or  docker context ls  to confirm no unauthenticated remote context

controls.control: Images are built from minimal, trusted base images and scanned for CVEs before deployment
controls.audit_step: Check the CI/CD pipeline's image-scan step output (Trivy/Grype/Clair) or the registry's vulnerability scan report

controls.control: Containers do not run as root unless explicitly required
controls.audit_step: docker inspect <container> --format '{{.Config.User}}'  or Pod spec securityContext.runAsNonRoot

controls.control: Secrets are not baked into images or environment variables in plaintext
controls.audit_step: trivy image --scanners secret <image>  or  docker history <image>

controls.control: Containers run with a read-only root filesystem where possible
controls.audit_step: docker inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}' <container>  or Pod securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem

controls.control: Resource limits (CPU/memory) are set to prevent noisy-neighbor/DoS
controls.audit_step: docker inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.Memory}} {{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}' <container>  or  kubectl describe pod <pod>  (Resources section)

controls.control: kube-apiserver anonymous auth is disabled and RBAC authorization mode is enforced
controls.audit_step: Check kube-apiserver manifest/flags for --anonymous-auth=false and --authorization-mode=RBAC

controls.control: etcd is encrypted at rest and access is restricted to control-plane nodes only
controls.audit_step: Check kube-apiserver's --encryption-provider-config flag, and etcd's network policy/firewall rules restricting access to control-plane nodes

controls.control: Audit logging is enabled on the API server
controls.audit_step: Check kube-apiserver's --audit-log-path and --audit-policy-file flags

controls.control: NetworkPolicies restrict pod-to-pod traffic to what's required
controls.audit_step: kubectl get networkpolicy --all-namespaces

controls.control: PodSecurity admission (or equivalent) blocks privileged/hostPath/hostNetwork pods by default
controls.audit_step: kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.labels}'  (pod-security.kubernetes.io labels) or review OPA/Gatekeeper policies

controls.control: Namespaces and RBAC RoleBindings scope access per team/tenant
controls.audit_step: kubectl get rolebindings,clusterrolebindings --all-namespaces

controls.control: Kubernetes Secrets are encrypted at rest or an external secrets manager (Vault, KMS) is used
controls.audit_step: Check the cluster's EncryptionConfiguration resource, or the external secrets manager (Vault/KMS) integration config

controls.control: Only images from an approved, scanned registry can be deployed (admission control/policy)
controls.audit_step: Review the admission controller policy (e.g. Kyverno/OPA image allowlist) or registry webhook configuration

controls.control: Safe Links and Safe Attachments (Defender for Office 365) are enabled

controls.control: Sensitivity labels and DLP policies are applied to sensitive content

controls.control: The Global Administrator role is limited to a minimal, monitored set of accounts, with PIM for just-in-time elevation

controls.control: Intune compliance policies require managed, encrypted, up-to-date devices before granting access

controls.control: External sharing for SharePoint/OneDrive is restricted to specific domains or disabled by default

controls.control: Super Admin accounts require security-key-based 2SV and are limited in number

controls.control: DMARC, DKIM, and SPF are configured for all sending domains

controls.control: External file sharing defaults are restricted rather than 'anyone with the link'

technologies.name: Web Application / API
technologies.legacy_name: Web Application / API (generic - no single CIS benchmark)

controls.control: MFA is available/enforced for privileged and customer-facing accounts
controls.audit_step: Attempt a login flow manually and review the IAM/Auth0/Okta MFA enforcement policy

controls.control: Session tokens are random, short-lived, and invalidated on logout/password change

controls.control: All user input is validated/sanitized server-side; parameterized queries used (no raw SQL concatenation)
controls.audit_step: Manual code review of the data-access layer for parameterized queries, plus a SAST/DAST scan (e.g. OWASP ZAP, Burp) for injection

controls.control: Authorization checks are enforced server-side on every request, not just in the UI

controls.control: TLS 1.2+ enforced; HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options headers set

controls.control: API keys/secrets are stored in a vault/secret manager, not in source control or client-side code
controls.audit_step: gitleaks detect  or  trufflehog  against the source repo; confirm vault/secret-manager integration in config

controls.control: Security-relevant events (auth failures, privilege changes) are logged without leaking sensitive data

controls.control: Third-party libraries/dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities on a regular cadence
controls.audit_step: Check the CI pipeline for npm audit / pip-audit / Snyk / Dependabot output

controls.control: Rate limiting / throttling is applied to authentication and other sensitive endpoints
controls.audit_step: Send a burst of requests to the login endpoint and observe the throttling response, or review the API gateway's rate-limit config

controls.control: PII/sensitive fields are encrypted at rest and masked in logs/non-prod environments
controls.audit_step: Review the DB schema/column-level encryption config and check log samples for masked sensitive fields

controls.control: Running a currently supported MySQL version; unused example/test databases removed
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SELECT VERSION(); SHOW DATABASES;'  (check for a leftover 'test' database)

controls.control: MySQL service runs under a dedicated non-root OS account
controls.audit_step: ps -ef | grep mysqld  — confirm the running OS user is not root

controls.control: Data directory and my.cnf permissions restricted to the mysql OS user only
controls.audit_step: ls -la /var/lib/mysql /etc/my.cnf

controls.control: Error/general logs are not world-readable
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log_error';'  then  ls -la <path returned>

controls.control: TLS is enabled and required for client connections (require_secure_transport)
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'require_secure_transport';'

controls.control: local_infile is disabled unless explicitly required
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'local_infile';'

controls.control: Default/anonymous accounts are removed or locked; root account has a strong password
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SELECT User,Host FROM mysql.user;'

controls.control: Password validation plugin enforces complexity, history and expiration
controls.audit_step: mysql -e 'SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'validate_password%';'

controls.control: SUPER, FILE, and PROCESS privileges are limited to admin/service accounts only

controls.control: Audit plugin or general query log captures security-relevant events

controls.control: Logs are forwarded to a central log server/SIEM

controls.control: PGDATA directory is owned by the postgres user with mode 0700

controls.control: Password encryption method is set to scram-sha-256

controls.control: SSL is enabled (ssl=on) with valid certificates

controls.control: Idle session / connection timeout is configured
controls.audit_step: psql -c 'SHOW idle_in_transaction_session_timeout;'

controls.control: WAL archiving/backups are encrypted at rest and restore has been tested

controls.control: SQL Server is on a supported version with the latest cumulative update applied

controls.control: xp_cmdshell is disabled unless explicitly required and documented

controls.control: Ad Hoc Distributed Queries and OLE Automation Procedures are disabled
controls.audit_step: EXEC sp_configure 'Ad Hoc Distributed Queries'; EXEC sp_configure 'Ole Automation Procedures';

controls.control: Windows Authentication is used where feasible; Mixed Mode is justified if enabled

controls.control: The sa account is disabled or renamed and has a strong, unique password

controls.control: Server and database roles follow least privilege; public role permissions are minimized
controls.audit_step: SELECT * FROM sys.database_role_members;  and review permissions granted to the public role

controls.control: SQL Server Audit (or equivalent) is enabled for logins, schema and permission changes
controls.audit_step: SELECT * FROM sys.server_audits;  and  SELECT * FROM sys.dm_server_audit_status;

controls.control: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) is enabled for databases holding sensitive data
controls.audit_step: SELECT name, is_encrypted FROM sys.databases;

controls.control: Force Encryption is enabled at the instance level for client connections

controls.control: Backups are encrypted and a restore has been tested within the last review cycle
